windowTitle: Serial integration stage 5 - I08 Serve never records the requested model configuration version as applied
scope: Close the section-11 red line that Serve must not write the requested modelConfigurationVersion as the applied fact. No contract, schema, migration, generator or external action changed.
implemented: services/serve/internal/delivery/runtime.go: RuntimeObservation carries AppliedModelConfigurationVersion, the version the executing runtime independently reported; recordDeploymentObservation persists that observed value instead of command.GetModelConfigurationVersion().
services/serve/internal/delivery/write.go+appendReadinessEvent: the serve.agent_readiness_observed.v1 event carries the independently observed applied version, not the requested one.

services/serve/internal/delivery/runtime_bridge.go+runtimeObservationReadback: StartRuntime's readback reports the observed applied version (0 until a runtime confirms one) rather than echoing the requested version.

services/serve/internal/delivery/runtime_postgres_test.go: TestServeNeverRecordsRequestedModelVersionAsApplied proves a requested version in the command leaves applied 0 until the runtime reports it, then records exactly the runtime-reported version.

verification.environment: local loopback PostgreSQL container for the owner-migration tests
cases: TestServeNeverRecordsRequestedModelVersionAsApplied: requested=7 with an unconfirmed runtime leaves applied_model_configuration_version=0; a runtime-reported 7 is recorded.
Existing Serve observation/route/lifecycle and Workspace runtime recovery suites still pass.

notRun: The publisher-contract opl-model-config/v1 apply/readback execution (PUT applyPath / GET readbackPath) is not yet driven by the Serve adapter: no producer currently reports the applied version, so the applied value is now honestly 0 rather than the requested version. That integration is the remaining I08 work and requires the publisher model-config contract to be admitted and executed.
No real runtime, TKE cluster, Candidate build, Instance deployment or production readback.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims a Cloud source correctness change with a focused isolated-PostgreSQL test: Serve never records the requested model configuration version as applied. It does not claim the publisher model-config apply/readback execution, a real runtime applied readback, deployment, Candidate or production acceptance.
